end.summary:
Reviewed how the East India Company changed from trader to ruler, from 1600 to 1858.
Zoya sequenced the Charter, Plassey, Buxar, Diwani, and Crown rule twice without prompts.
Discussed trade goods, forts, revenue, and the importance of Diwani after 1765.
The lesson ended when Zoya said they were tired; the teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Zoya practised building a historical sequence and explaining cause and effect, especially how Plassey and Diwani increased Company control. They clearly explained that revenue collection provided regular income and funded exports, armies, and forts. No factual mix-up was noted, so there was nothing to correct later in the lesson. At home, ask them to retell the timeline using five headings: Charter, Plassey, Buxar, Diwani, and Crown.
